memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Her husband may confirm or nullify any vow she makes or any sworn pledge to deny herself. But if her husband says nothing to her about it from day to day, then he confirms all her vows or the pledges binding on her. He confirms them by saying nothing to her when he hears about them. If, however, he nullifies them some time after he hears about them, then he must bear the consequences of her wrongdoing." - Num 30:13-15 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The regulations close with a notable provision. If a husband annulled his wife's vow belatedly, after previously letting it stand, he himself would bear the consequences of releasing her from it. In other words, responsibility for the broken obligation fell on him rather than on her. He would carry the weight of that decision.

This is a striking picture of one person bearing the consequences that might otherwise fall on another. Within the household order of ancient Israel, the one in the position of responsibility could take upon himself the burden that would have rested on the vulnerable one. Someone bore the cost so that the other could go free.

We should be careful not to over-read a single detail, yet we cannot help but see a faint reflection of a greater truth. There is One who took upon Himself the full weight of consequences we could never bear. Where we had broken every obligation to God, He stepped in to carry the cost on our behalf.

That One is Jesus Christ. He bore our sins in His body on the cross, taking the consequences of our wrongdoing so that we could be released and set free (1 Pet 2:24). What no husband or father could ultimately do, Christ did perfectly and forever. He carried our burden completely. Rest in the Saviour who bore the consequences of your sin so that you might go free.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. What does it mean that someone can bear consequences on another's behalf?
2. How does this passage faintly reflect what Christ did for you?
3. Have you received the release Christ offers by bearing your sin?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord Jesus, You bore the full weight of my sin on the cross, taking the consequences I could never carry. Thank You for setting me free through Your sacrifice. Help me to rest in the release You have won. Amen.
